## Trial `scheduled-maintenance-rhel10__XxbRYCE`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor satisfied the task contract: it repaired a corrupted (non-executable, heredoc-mangled) script found at /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance, made it a valid 0755 root:root executable, installed a root cron entry for 02:15 daily that redirects output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log, and verified end-to-end behavior both before and after a full node restart performed per the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol. Boot-identity, cron persistence, service state, and log content were all directly observed pre- and post-restart, consistent with the fixed global lifecycle snapshots.

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **req-cron-schedule — Satisfied:** Cron schedules /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance to run daily at 02:15 on node1
  - **Why:** Root crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' was installed and confirmed both in crontab -l output and persisted in /var/spool/cron/root. The entry survived a full node restart intact, confirming durable installation. Natural firing at 02:15 was not observed (would require waiting for the scheduled time), but the exact invocation cron will use was manually exercised and produced correct results.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-f0927383fac9448d`, `cmd-555a29ad149b4843`, `cmd-97ea0bedd4ac41a0`
- **req-script-executable — Satisfied:** /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance exists as a valid, runnable executable
  - **Why:** The prepared file (baseline hash 385431df..., mode 644) was found by the executor to contain literal heredoc/shell text instead of a working script (cmd-601de518d8014b27 shows a corrupted file body ending in a bare SCRIPT delimiter followed by stray chown/chmod lines, and it was not executable per the baseline stat). The executor rewrote it as a clean POSIX sh script, set 0755 root:root, and confirmed it runs and prints the expected line.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-601de518d8014b27`, `cmd-27671cfb9e4f4e91`, `cmd-42ca2a4ec2b44c93`
- **req-log-retention — Satisfied:** Script output is retained in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
  - **Why:** The log file was created (root:root), the script was run through the exact redirection cron will use ('>> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'), and the output line was confirmed appended. A second run after the node restart appended a further correctly formatted line, confirming append semantics persist across restarts.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-555a29ad149b4843`, `cmd-0ede0352f17b439e`, `cmd-029772cfcb1847b7`
- **req-node-restart-evidence — Satisfied:** Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol executed on node1 (pre-restart baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state)
  - **Why:** Pre-restart baseline captured boot_id 368725cb..., crond active, crontab entry, and log content. A self-acknowledging backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' returned before disconnect. Exec calls timed out during the reboot window then succeeded with a new boot_id (1c0f7716...), matching the fixed global before_prepare/after_prepare (368725cb...) vs after_executor (1c0f7716...) boot-identity snapshots. Post-restart, crond, the crontab entry, the executable script, and prior log content were all confirmed intact, and a fresh manual run appended correctly.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-8f0897749af84902`, `cmd-1ffc3e786bdf4334`, `cmd-ea85778bedc445bb`, `cmd-22213abb60c247e7`, `cmd-56edfef4d25a4cae`, `cmd-97ea0bedd4ac41a0`, `cmd-029772cfcb1847b7`, `global:before_prepare:node1:boot-identity`, `global:after_prepare:node1:boot-identity`, `global:after_executor:node1:boot-identity`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.900**. All state-changing commands trace to a material outcome, a necessary prerequisite (fixing a genuinely corrupted script file, evidenced by cmd-601de518d8014b27), or bounded evidence collection (manual runs to append verification output, the mandated restart). The one incidental residue is /tmp/reboot.log, a small artifact left by the backgrounded 'nohup sh -c ...systemctl reboot...' command (cmd-1ffc3e786bdf4334) used to acknowledge the restart before disconnect; it appears in the after_executor temporary-files snapshot and was not cleaned up. No failed services, no unsafe exposure changes (listening sockets differ only by expected post-reboot sshd PID), and package health remained consistent (dnf, no errors) across all snapshots.
